capabilities: Open .pptx files from the file explorer in a dedicated read-only view
Extract and navigate slide text and speaker notes
List media references and metadata for each slide
Show package diagnostics and warnings for external relationships, OLE content, macros, and malformed packages
Filter extracted slide text, notes, and media metadata
disambiguation: Not a Markdown slide authoring or presentation tool like the Slides core feature; it only displays existing .pptx files read-only.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README states no network calls, no editing, and no external app launch.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or inspect PowerPoint files, so users must leave the app or convert decks just to read their contents.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .pptx files inside Obsidian, showing slide text, speaker notes, media references, and package diagnostics.
